findingClass: the deploying user's crontab has no (or more than one) '# ipodhan-scraper-wake:<slot>' line for a slot, or that line does not invoke the slot's current symlink at its cadence (*/30 prod, 15,45 staging) -- after #660 removed pm2's --cron-restart, cron is the ONLY thing that wakes the scraper, and pm2 status can no longer tell you the wake is alive
failThreshold: for either slot, crontab -l does not contain exactly one line matching /# ipodhan-scraper-wake:<slot>/ that starts with that slot's cadence and invokes its current symlink
unverifiableWhen: crontab is not reachable on this host (expected on a dev machine or CI; runs for real on the box via cron)
